body: A reviewed audit11a45c1/result e7109d32 and approves bounded SOURCE-ONLY implementation in document/filters.rs: private FilterEvalError/Result; preserve typed EngineError::Cancelled through Spec::run, run_effect and eval_stack; explicit compatibility into_bridge and NativeFilterEvaluator into_engine; same live effect/native cancellation pair. Drain all already-running block results, genuine observed failure wins cancellation in either arrival order; never publish partial output. Preserve first-arrival genuine-failure semantics, no new scheduling/global memory promises. Add proposed tiny deterministic typed/checkpoint/error-race/productioncollector tests. Scope excludes compositor, psd_copy.rs, io.rs, document.rs, generated bindings and Swift. A engine Sol is concurrently adding only a borrowed RequestCancellation.native accessor in filters.rs and copyIO wiring; do not change that struct/accessor area, and publish a separate commit for A to apply. No B compiler/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart. Sourceformat/diffcheck only; all tests UNRUN, A validates/merges. Editing-readiness smoke is active on A, independent of this fix.
